title: JSON Video Studio project
description: Authoring contract for json-video/v1. All asset paths are local and relative to the project file.

split.description: auto (default) splits a subtitle that does not fit one line into sentence cues timed to the narration; none always shows the whole subtitle.

fontFamily.description: v0.1 uses the Noto Sans CJK JP family bundled in the Docker image so resolved and rendered output use the same locked font.

frame.description: Slide-deck frame: gradient background, white content card, footer with logo, footer text and page number, chapter chips and progress line at the bottom, and a cover layout for title/outro visuals. Colors come from palette (brand-neutral defaults).

palette.description: Frame colors. Omitted keys fall back to neutral defaults.

footer.description: Bottom chrome of the deck frame. full (default) = logo/footer text, chapter chips and page number; progress = only the thin progress line, and the content card and subtitle get the freed space; none = no chrome.

highlight.description: Zero-based item indexes to emphasize. Other items are dimmed. Consecutive scenes that differ only by highlight keep the layout on screen.

highlightLines.description: One-based line numbers to emphasize; other lines stay readable. Consecutive scenes that differ only by highlightLines keep the code on screen.

emphasis.description: Exact substrings of text to emphasize with the accent color.

emphasisTerms.description: Exact substrings of the block text to emphasize.

highlightIndexes.description: Zero-based item indexes to emphasize; the other items are dimmed.

numbering.description: Label drawn before each step title: number (default: 1, 2, 3), chapter (第1章 …) or none.

slideVisual.description: A composed slide page: tag + title header and up to six blocks in a 12-column grid. Consecutive scenes with the same slide keep the page on screen and only move emphasis.

scale.description: Enlarges every block of the page. Use large/xlarge when the page has little content instead of leaving small text in a mostly empty card.

align.description: Vertical placement of the blocks inside the card (default top).

navigation.description: Persistent chapter bar shown above every scene. Each group bundles one or more sections in order.

speechText.description: Explicit synthesis text; overrides the project pronunciation dictionary without changing displayed text or subtitles.

oneOf.description: A user-supplied audio asset determines the duration. speakerId and text may still drive avatar and subtitles.
VOICEVOX generates audio from a speaker and text.
A silent scene has an explicit duration and no speaker or audio asset.

video.description: v0.1 always renders the primary MP4.

storyboard.description: v0.1 always generates storyboard assets for the mandatory review gate.

diagramVisual.description: Connection diagram: 2-5 nodes in a row, optional groups enclosing adjacent nodes, links between nodes, and an active state (emphasized nodes/links and a labelled packet moving along one link). Consecutive scenes that differ only by active keep the diagram on screen.

active.description: Emphasis for this scene. nodes and groups are ids to emphasize; links and packet.link are zero-based indexes into links; packet.reverse sends the packet from `to` back to `from`.

nestVisual.description: Containment diagram: one outer box that contains up to four boxes, each of which may contain up to four boxes. highlight lists the ids to emphasize.

timelineVisual.description: Timeline: 1-4 tracks of segments on one shared axis from 0 to end. highlight lists segment ids to emphasize and cursor draws a position line that moves between scenes. Consecutive scenes that differ only by highlight/cursor keep the timeline on screen.
